summary: Reworks the Job task panel Setup tab: Model/Stock selection-target toggle buttons replace the single picking toggle, the Alignment and Origin & Orientation groups are merged into Origin & Alignment with renamed Center XYZ/XY in Stock buttons, the move pad loses diagonals and gains Z up/down plus a unit-aware step, rotation gains an X/Y/Z axis selector, Set Origin now accepts any edge midpoint, and stock extension and move-step defaults become 0.125"/0.1" under imperial units.

pages.reason: PathEdit.ui: 'Alignment' group becomes 'Selection Target' with Model/Stock toggle buttons; 'Origin && Orientation' becomes 'Origin && Alignment'; 'Center in Stock'/'XY in Stock' renamed 'Center XYZ in Stock'/'Center XY in Stock'; diagonal move arrows removed, Z up/down added, modelRotateAxis combo added. Gui/Job.py: modelRotate uses selected axis (X/Y/Z, default Z); isValidDatumSelection no longer rejects non-circular edges and alignMoveToOrigin uses edge midpoint; modelMoveValue is a QuantitySpinBox defaulting to 0.1 in under imperial. Stock.py: ExtX/Y/Zneg/pos default 3.175 mm when user unit is inch; stock view defaults change to tan dotted Flat Lines, Transparency 95, Selectable False.

Path.qrc and Gui/Resources/icons/: 21 new SVG icons added (arrow-ccw/cw-x/y/z, arrow-up/down-y/z, arrow-left/right-x, center-in-stock, xy-in-stock, model, stock, move-to-origin, set-origin, origin-x/y/z) in the directory the page catalogues.

meta.title: CAM: Update Job Task Panel GUI
